provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Complete assigned index.html, sources.md, independent-check.md and model-inputs.json read locally after the package README and voice guide; batch37 Markdown and data inspected for format only. No other run folder, network research, build or publication during batch39 authoring.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Strict clean-session-only retrieval was not met in the original research: public fetch tools automatically used an existing managed-browser profile for several pages. Later clean reads (RBA, Canterbury) and the independent check improve reliability but do not retroactively cure this. Some Home Affairs pages returned empty shells, so the Australian 485 details (92-week equivalence, qualification-duration mapping, second-visa residence conditions) stay preliminary. The Payscale NZ figure is non-primary and unconfirmed.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: The independent check recomputed all five cost models and every displayed derived amount with Python Decimal and found no substantive money error. A savings-deadline error in the first draft (THB 13,333 a month over 15 months) was corrected to twelve deposits of about THB 16,667 a month, December 2026 to November 2027; the stress shortfall of THB 106,882 and base margin of THB 148,289 were added; a blanket future-price statement was corrected to except Canterbury's published 2028 NZD 62,400. The check kept the Christchurch recommendation conditional and left admission equivalence, exact Thai student charge, 2028 intakes and fees, levies and insurance, renewal-visa costs, official NZ graduate pay and detailed Australian 485 conditions open. This page follows the final index.html, whose hash matches the audited version.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No batch39 build, rendered HTML, browser or print certification. The original run recorded desktop and mobile layout checks for its own index.html only; they do not certify these Markdown pages.

datePolicy: Every source access date is the original 2026-11-07 read date. Fee years, effective dates and future intake dates are separate and appear beside each figure; no 2028 fee other than Canterbury's published NZD 62,400, and no 2028 rule or quote, is assumed. Copy editing and localization are not a source refresh.

planningAssumptions.profile: Nattaporn, 24, Bangkok; BEng civil engineering, GPA 3.1 (grading scale not stated), two years on site, THB 32,000 a month, THB 2,500,000 family support
planningAssumptions.intake: February 2028 (intended; not confirmed by any university)
planningAssumptions.fx: RBA 6 November 2026: AUD 1 = THB 23.12; AUD 1 = NZD 1.2401; NZD 1 = THB 18.64365777
planningAssumptions.tuitionEscalation: 5% once from 2027 fee year to 2028, held constant; Canterbury 2028 fee not inflated
planningAssumptions.contingency: 10% on study plus transition cash; additional 10% adverse FX stress
planningAssumptions.taxPayrollReserve: 25% of gross, not a tax calculation
planningAssumptions.thaiSavingsAssumption: THB 10,000 a month for stay-home comparison

uncertainties: Admission: Thai BEng and GPA 3.1 equivalence for every university (Canterbury Academic Equivalent Standing and dean approval; UQ/Adelaide 4.5/7.0; Auckland GPE 4.0); admission is not guaranteed
February 2028 intake dates, 2028 annual fees (other than Canterbury NZD 62,400), RMIT campus (City versus Bundoora) and Auckland 180-point 1.5-year duration and March start
Exact Thai student visa application charge for Australia (ASEAN concession) and NZ charges; NZ post-study work visa fee (NZD 2,000 is an assumption)

Australian 485 details preliminary: 92-week equivalence, qualification-duration mapping, Adelaide second-visa regional and two-year residence conditions; Australian financial-capacity proposals under consultation until 23 November 2026
Canterbury eligible on-campus weeks and visa-eligible delivery; MEM-specific English level not independently excluded
Living, insurance and levy figures are analyst allowances, not quotes; Melbourne has no verified all-in annual total; Auckland/UQ price years differ
NZ graduate pay is a non-primary Payscale sample (NZD 64,961 average, 29 profiles); no official NZ graduate salary series; Australian pay is broad-field survey data, not job titles
Funding gate: THB 200,000 personal savings by November 2027 is a target; a 10% adverse exchange-rate move still leaves THB 106,882 unfunded
Original managed-browser exception remains; no perfect clean-session certification
editingContract: Only new data/thai-engineer-masters-australia-vs-new-zealand.json, en and th Markdown for this slug, and checks/batch39-thai-engineer-masters-australia-vs-new-zealand-notes.md. localeReason: Thai serves this decision directly: the scenario person is a Bangkok-based Thai engineer and the family funding discussion, THB conversions and funding gate are easiest to act on in Thai. The Thai page changes no eligibility, grade equivalence or visa rule; English remains the source version and the universities and immigration authorities publish in English.
